title: IntegralIdealProperCohomology
statement: Let f:X -> T be proper with T affine and its global-section ring R Noetherian. Let i:Z -> X be a closed immersion with Z integral, and let I be an ideal sheaf given by Z.IdealSheafData. For every q >= 0, H^q(X,i_* I) is a finite R-module, where the R-action is restriction of scalars along f.appTop.

source.place: Tags 02O5 and 01YH, integral-support part of the proof

proof.text: Use Noetherian induction on integral closed supports. For each support, Chow's projective modification and a common relatively ample twist yield a coherent generic-rank-one module with finite cohomology. Projective cohomology finiteness must come independently from the projective-space case, rather than the projective higher-image theorem proved from proper coherence. Derived composition and relative twisting vanishing identify the needed cohomology.

The generic-rank-one comparison of Tag 01YH embeds a nonzero ideal into the Chow module. Compare any ideal with that one via their nonzero intersection. The cokernels have smaller support and are finite in cohomology by induction; the long exact sequence gives finiteness for the ideal. Smaller-support modules are reduced by the integral-ideal filtration. Zero ideals have zero cohomology. All maps are linear over the base ring. The induction concerns finiteness in every degree simultaneously; the long exact sequence proves two-out-of-three, with the preceding term zero in degree zero.

lean.statement:
theorem finite_H_pushforward_integral_ideal {X T : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ T) [IsProper f] [IsAffine T] [IsNoetherianRing Γ(T, ⊤)]
    (Z : Scheme.{u}) (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsIntegral Z]
    (I : Z.IdealSheafData) (q : ℕ) :
    letI : Module Γ(T, ⊤) (((pushforward i).obj I.toModules).H q) :=
      Module.compHom _ f.appTop.hom
    Module.Finite Γ(T, ⊤) (((pushforward i).obj I.toModules).H q)
